responsibility: Generates the compressed C tables and enumerations that describe x86 builtin scalar, vector, pointer, and function types. This build-time awk script parses the declarative type file i386-builtin-types.def, validates references, synthesizes the ix86 builtin type and function-type enums and lookup arrays, and emits the auto-generated include used by the i386 builtins implementation to lazily construct builtin trees.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-builtin-types.def, which is the declarative list of builtin types and function signatures, this file is the generator script that parses that .def data, validates it, and emits the compressed enums and tables used by the x86 builtins code.
